units.role: shunt regulator: the device sinks Cathode 2 current so Reference 1 sits at Vref = 1.24 V above Anode 3 (Rev. 27 p1 Figure 1, p2 Figure 2, p3)
identity_features: onsemi TLV431A/D Rev. 27 p2 Figure 2 device symbol upright inside a 20.32 x 15.24 mm body: a filled triangle (22-vertex serpentine under the 0.254 stroke) pointing up from the Anode lead to the shunt-regulator bar, bar ticks left down / right up

Cathode 2 at the top of the left edge (-15.24, 5.08), its lead running right and dropping onto the bar centre; Reference 1 directly below (-15.24, 2.54), its lead ending on the triangle's left side at mid-height, so the U9/U16 Reference-to-Cathode tie is one 2.54 mm wire
Anode 3 a bottom pin (0, -12.70), its lead leaving the triangle base, running left at y 0 and dropping to the pin
graft G1: 'V_{ref} =' over '1.24 V' in the lower-right quadrant (p1 Figure 1 '1.24 Vref'; p3 TLV431B Vref)
all three pins passive, named in full as onsemi prints them (Reference, Cathode, Anode), names and numbers shown
